_how_to_add: Add a past paper here. Key = subject slug (same as /subjects/<slug>). Each item: id (unique, e.g. '2027' or '2027-ii'), year, title, optional paper ('I' or 'II'), and EITHER pdf (a direct .pdf link, or a file you placed in public/papers/, e.g. '/papers/current-affairs/2027.pdf') OR page+file for a The CSS Point download. The paper opens inside the app.
